notes.title: "Dome-King Cabbage" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content: [h1]"Dome-King Cabbage" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025[/h1][h2]Play the Latest Demo at Makuhari Messe![/h2][p][/p][p]"Dome-King Cabbage" is officially announced to participate in Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025), held at Makuhari Messe from September 25 (Thursday) to September 28 (Sunday), 2025. Attendees will have the opportunity to experience the latest playable demo of the game at the dedicated booth, and we will also be running a campaign where those who add the game to their Wishlist will receive an original acrylic keychain. [/p][p]*Please note that numbers are limited.[/p][p][/p][h3]Exhibition Details[/h3][quote][p][b]Dates:[/b] September 25 (Thursday) - September 28 (Sunday), 2025[/p][p][b]Times:[/b][/p][p]Business Days (September 25 - 26): 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 27): 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 28): 9:30 AM - 4:30 PM[/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Makuhari Messe[/p][p][b]Booth Name:[/b] HYPER REAL[/p][p][b]Location:[/b] Hall 11 | Booth Number E19[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We look forward to welcoming you to our booth![/p]

notes.title: Dome-King Cabbage will be exhibiting at TGS 2024!
notes.content:
[h2]Dome-King Cabbage will be exhibiting at Makuhari Messe Convention Center for TGS 2024[/h2]

From Sept. 26th (Thurs) to Sept. 29th (Sun), Dome-King Cabbage will be exhibiting at Makuhari Messe Convention Center for TGS 2024. You can play the latest demo at the booth!

[h3]Exhibition Overview[/h3]
[quote=author] Schedule: 2024/9/26（THURS）～2024/9/29（SUN）
　　　(THURS) Business Day　10:00 - 17:00
　　　(FRI) Business Day　10:00 - 17:00
　　　(SAT) Public Day　　10:00 - 17:00
　　　(SUN) Public Day　　9:30 - 16:30
Location: Makuhari Messe Convention Center
Booth Name: HYPER REAL
Booth Location: Hall 9｜Booth #09-W36[/quote]
Dome-King Cabbage will also be exhibited in the Selected Indie 80 corner, where 80 titles were hand selected by a jury to exhibit at TGS.


[h3]Selected Indie 80 Exhibition Details[/h3]
[quote=author] Schedule: Same as above
Location: Makuhari Messe Convention Center
Booth Name: Cobysoft Joe
Booth Location: Hall 10｜Booth A39[/quote]
Depending on their availability, the developer will be in attendance at the booth as well!


Additionally, the IGN JAPAN STORE, located in Hall 11｜Booth #C10, will be selling graphic tees for Dome Cabbage.

This will the first time HYPER REAL has sold Dome-King Cabbage goods, so come on by and get them while you can!

We look forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Dome-King Cabbage In Attendance At Gamescom 2024!
notes.content:
[h3] Dome-King Cabbage will be exhibited at Gamescom 2024 in Cologne! [/h3]

Dome-King Cabbage will be exhibited at Gamescom, which will be held this year from Wednesday August 21st to Sunday August 25th at the Koelnmesse GmbH exhibition center.

The latest demo will be playable at the Polish Indie Booth.

notes.title: Dome-King Cabbage Coming to Bitsummit Drift in KYOTO!
notes.content:
[h3] Dome-King Cabbage Coming will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift in Kyoto! [/h3]

Dome-King Cabbage Coming will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift, which will be held from Friday 19th July to Sunday 21st July 2024 at the Kyoto Kangyo-Kan Miyako Messe.

At the booth, you will be able to play the latest demo and get HYPER REAL novelty items.
*Number of items is limited

[h2]Exhibition Overview[/h2]
[quote=author] Dates: 2024/7/19 (Fri) - 2024/7/21 (Sun) 9:00-17:00
Venue: Kyoto Kangyo-Kan "Miyako Messe", 3F, Exhibition Hall 3
Booth Name: HYPER REAL
Booth Location: IP-17[/quote]

We look forward to meeting you!
Cobysoft Joe & HYPER REAL
